kind: Isolated numeric saved-block repair integration validation, official 1.22.7
limits: Disposable copy of a stopped test world, no production server or authenticated clients.
Repair scan counts existing saved chunks; unsaved edits and inventories are excluded.
Block entities at matching source positions are refused; generic inventory migrations are not attempted.
World-ID and block registry binding apply, and writes require the pre-terrain AssetsFinalize phase.
Lighting, heightmaps and map exports are preserved and may require refreshing.
